resources.string: Choose the access you want to allow. You can continue without optional access and enable it later in Android settings.
Allow notifications to use the app’s Start flow and see lighting controls and capture requests. You can still explore the app and run this temporary LED test without them.

Optional for Ambient screen colors using Accessibility. Enable DuoFrost in Android’s Accessibility settings. This access can read your screen; allow it only if you want this capture method. Android screen-sharing is also available when you start a capture effect.
Optional for app profiles and game scenes. Usage access lets DuoFrost identify the foreground app and choose its assigned lighting. Manual presets work without it.
These Android settings could not be opened. You can find DuoFrost in Android’s app settings.
Tap a preset on the dashboard to select your lighting. Use Settings to change its colors, effect and brightness, then save your changes. Search and collections help you find presets.
Start turns on the selected effect. Stop turns off the lighting. Mute temporarily darkens a running effect. Use one LED controller at a time: stop other lighting apps before testing DuoFrost.

Ambient effects use your screen colors. Android can ask for screen-sharing consent for each capture session. App profiles and Smart Scenes can choose presets automatically after you enable them; basic colors need no screen capture.

Device settings contains background continuation and battery options. Android can still stop the app. DuoFrost stays out of Recent apps; reopen it using the app icon and use Stop to turn off the lighting.

Check red, green, blue, white and each stick. Compare your LEDs with the expected colors below. Test brightness is capped at 25%; your brightness limits and mute still apply. The test stops when you leave this screen or after 60 seconds without a test action.
Test stopped. Restart it to check the colors.
Check your LEDs, then confirm this color to continue.

Stop other LED apps, check that lighting is not muted and that the brightness limit is above zero. DuoFrost needs compatible AYN LED hardware and firmware. You can retry or enter the app to check Device settings.
Compatible LED hardware could not be reached on this device. Your LEDs have not been verified.
The test could not be sent. Your LEDs have not been verified.
You confirmed all six LED checks. The temporary test has stopped.
The lighting test is unresolved. Check Device settings and use LED test again after starting lighting.
You can now choose your presets and start lighting. This setup has not enabled automatic app presets or background startup.
Some permissions are still off. Their related features will ask for access when needed.
